case_number: 2025 INSC 87; SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CIVIL) NO.13984 OF 2023

parties.respondent: The State of Odisha and Ors.

summary: Promotion eligibility for Tracer post: dispute over qualification requirements; statutory Sub-ordinate Architectural Service Rules, 1979 mandate direct recruitment for Tracer posts; petitioner's Tracer Training certificate insufficient per Rule 5(1)(e); State's incorrect documentation as 'department letter' instead of Gazette rules; High Court erred in relying on flawed documents; discrimination claim dismissed; no feeder cadre for Peon-to-Tracer promotion.
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; High Court judgment upheld; petitioner not entitled to promotion as Tracer due to ineligibility under statutory rules.
